lane: Mobile + content: Lô 5 of the Bầu trời hôm nay / Bản đồ số / Tôi là ai plan (Nhịp thời gian, Hợp số, AI 'Lời nhắn riêng' privacy contract)
goal: Do the app-side part of Lô 5 from docs/proposals/ASTRO_NUMEROLOGY_IMPLEMENTATION_2026-11-23.vi.md sections 3, 4, 5 and 8: (1) Nhịp thời gian on the Bản đồ số result: personal year, month and day (year changes on 1 January, no masters), the four pinnacles with approximate age ranges and the current one, and the four challenges (0 allowed, no past-life wording); (2) Hợp số: compare the person's life path, soul urge and expression with a second person's, describing common ground and tension only (no score, no %, no 'hợp/khắc'), with the second person's birth date and name kept in memory only (never saved, sent, shared or logged); (3) AI 'Lời nhắn riêng' as a 'Sắp có' card plus a pure, tested payload builder that contains only computed numbers and content block ids, never a name or a birth date. The backend part (Edge Function, prompt, quota, SQL) is written up as a proposal for separate Owner approvals and is not coded or deployed. The 'tách rút lá khỏi AI diễn giải' item is already on main (PR #46, Gói 0); it only waits for the Owner to apply migration 20261116100000 and deploy ai-tarot-reading, so it is reported, not re-implemented.
successCriteria: calc.ts gains personalCycles(birth, today), pinnacles(birth) with age ranges, challenges(birth) and currentPinnacle(birth, today); every case of the masters11_22_only golden variant and the personalCycles golden cases matches 100%.
Personal year changes on 1 January (local device date) and never keeps 11/22; pinnacles keep 11/22 by D1 (no 33); challenges reduce parts to one digit and allow 0.
Bản đồ số result shows a 'Nhịp thời gian' section (year, month, light day line, pinnacle stages with approximate ages and the current stage marked, challenges) from numerology-blocks.json.

Hợp số section: the second person's birth date (and optional name) are held in component state only; no storage key, no share card, no analytics metadata, no network request contains them; leaving the screen clears them.
Hợp số text has no score, percentage, ranking or 'hợp/khắc' wording; it lists common ground and tension per compared number.
The AI payload builder output contains only number labels, block ids, language and a version; a test proves the name, normalized name and birth date never appear in its serialized form.
'Lời nhắn riêng' shows a 'Sắp có' label and states what would be sent; no AI call is made.
New content keys are bilingual with accented Vietnamese, marked draft with the existing review block, and pass the banned-word scan in tests and validate:data.
tsc, mobile jest suite, mobile:check and validate:data pass.
untouchedSurfaces: No Edge Function, prompt, model route, quota, feature switch, SQL or migration is added or changed; the AI backend is a written proposal only.
Tarot draw/interpret separation: no code change (already on main via PR #46); its migration and deploy stay Owner actions.
apps/mobile/App.tsx is not changed (the numerology screen already receives what it needs).
share-events allowlist, share landing page and Who Am I chips are not changed.
No new storage key: the second person's data is never stored.

impact.entryPoint: Khám phá -> Bản đồ số -> result screen: new sections 'Nhịp thời gian', 'Hợp số' and the 'Lời nhắn riêng · Sắp có' card below the existing layers 1-2. Back behaviour unchanged.
impact.dataWrite: None new. The person's own name stays under nilaza.numerology.v1 as before; the second person's date and name live only in React state.
impact.backendContract: None. aiPayload.ts defines the future request body shape (numbers + block ids) for the proposal; nothing calls it at runtime.
impact.privacySafety: Second person's birth data is another person's data: memory only, not sent, not logged, not in share cards; the proposal lists the Data safety wording the Owner must confirm before any release that sends numbers to AI.
impact.observability: Optional events numerology_time_viewed / numerology_compat_compared carry no date, no name and no number.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit; no data migration.
